policies.title: Full British citizen passport: Tunisia visa-free short visit
policies.summary: FCDO records visa-free Tunisian visits up to 90 days for full British citizen passport holders.
conditions: Limited to a full British citizen passport from the UK and up to 90 days.
Crown Dependency passport holders may need a visa on arrival and are excluded; document, onward-travel, accommodation and final-admission conditions remain applicable.

policies.title: Full British citizen passport: Djibouti tourist visa on arrival
policies.summary: FCDO says full British citizen passport holders can buy a tourist visa on arrival in Djibouti.
conditions: Limited to a full British citizen passport from the UK and the stated tourist route.
Cash payment in US dollars and evidence of onward travel are stated conditions. An online application is also available but is not needed to establish this arrival-issued route.

policies.title: Full British citizen passport: Iraq electronic visa
policies.summary: FCDO says a full British citizen passport holder must apply before travel through the Government of Iraq e-visa portal.
conditions: The ordinary visitor visa must be applied for through the stated Iraqi government e-visa portal at least 24 hours before travel; FCDO says visit visas on arrival are no longer available for Iraq.
The KRI has a separate e-visa and arrival route that is valid only in the Kurdistan Region and is not this Iraq-wide baseline. Return/onward ticket and final-admission conditions remain applicable.

policies.title: Full British citizen passport: Comoros visa on arrival
policies.summary: FCDO says full British citizen passport holders can buy a Comoros visa on arrival at Hahaya airport or other entry points.
conditions: Limited to a full British citizen passport from the UK and the stated arrival issuance at Hahaya airport or other entry points.
The stated price is 30 euros; transit, document, health, special-passport and final-admission rules are not normalized.

policies.title: Full British citizen passport: Sudan advance visa
policies.summary: FCDO directs full British citizen passport holders to apply for a Sudanese visa through the Sudanese Embassy.
conditions: The page applies to a full British citizen passport from the UK.
The source identifies an embassy application route. Exit-visa, sponsor, travel-permit, Israeli-travel-document, health, purpose and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Full British citizen passport: Ukraine visa-free short visit
policies.summary: FCDO says full British citizen passport holders may enter Ukraine visa-free for up to 90 days in 180 days, continuing until 30 January 2027.
conditions: Limited to a full British citizen passport from the UK and visits of up to 90 days in 180 days; FCDO says Ukraine confirmed continuation until 30 January 2027.
Martial-law border accessibility, non-government-controlled-area permits, residence, work, document, security and final-admission rules remain separate.

policies.title: Full British citizen passport: British Virgin Islands visa-free short visit
policies.summary: FCDO says a full British citizen passport holder from the UK may visit BVI visa-free for up to one month.
conditions: This is confined to the catalog's GB full British citizen passport from the UK; it is not a rule for every British nationality, Crown Dependency passport or BVI belonger status.
The one-month arrival entry stamp is not a visa on arrival. Extensions, work, residence, online embarkation card, document and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Full British citizen passport: Cuba tourist electronic visa
policies.summary: FCDO says a full British citizen passport holder may obtain Cuba's tourist electronic visa, which is linked to the applicant's passport.
conditions: A tourist visa is required before travel. FCDO says the electronic-visa is linked to the passport after approval and a code is entered in the D'Viajeros process.
A paper tourist visa route also exists. Onward/return travel, the D'Viajeros arrival form, tourism purpose, document and final-admission conditions remain applicable.

policies.title: Full British citizen passport: Panama visa-free land or air short visit
policies.summary: FCDO says a full British citizen passport holder can visit Panama visa-free for up to three months when arriving by land or air.
conditions: Limited to a full British citizen passport from the UK, land or air arrival, and a visit of up to three months.
Sea arrivals other than cruise ships require a visa; cruise/Panama Canal and over-three-month rules are separately qualified. Immigration discretion and final admission remain applicable.

policies.title: Full British citizen passport: Bosnia and Herzegovina visa-free short visit
policies.summary: FCDO records visa-free travel to Bosnia and Herzegovina for a full British citizen passport for up to 90 days in six months.
conditions: Limited to tourist, family/friends, business-meeting, cultural/sport, short-study or training visits and up to 90 days in six months.
Residence, other travel purposes, entry/exit stamp, document and final-admission requirements remain separate.

policies.title: Full British citizen passport: Turkmenistan sponsored visa on arrival
policies.summary: FCDO says a full British citizen passport holder may purchase a Turkmenistan visa on arrival after obtaining a letter of invitation.
conditions: A letter of invitation is mandatory before travel; for tourist visits, authorised travel agents can provide it.

The stated arrival route is at Ashgabat International Airport and some land borders, with current land-border details to be checked with the sponsor. It does not normalize transit visas, work, purpose, sponsor, entry point or final-admission conditions.

policies.title: Full British citizen passport: Central African Republic advance visa
policies.summary: FCDO directs full British citizen passport holders to apply through the Central African Republic Embassy in Paris.
conditions: The page applies to a full British citizen passport from the UK.
This is an embassy application route; requirements may change and health, transport, purpose, document and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Full British citizen passport: Gabon advance visa
policies.summary: FCDO says a full British citizen passport holder must apply for a Gabon visa before travelling.
conditions: The page applies to a full British citizen passport from the UK and explicitly requires application before travel.
Business invitation, tourist accommodation, yellow-fever, document and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Full British citizen passport: Equatorial Guinea online pre-approval and arrival-issued visa
policies.summary: FCDO describes an online application whose e-visa letter is presented on arrival and the visa is issued by border officials.
conditions: This is not classified as an electronically issued visa: FCDO says the applicant prints the online e-visa letter and border officials issue the visa on arrival.
A physical embassy route is also available. Processing, passport-stamp, yellow-fever, purpose, document and final-admission conditions remain applicable.

conflicts.explanation: FCDO expressly permits purchase of a visa on arrival after the mandatory letter of invitation, at named entry points.
FCDO expressly says a visa must be applied for before travel and identifies the High Commission route; it does not establish electronic issuance.
FCDO says the online letter is printed and border officials issue the visa, so the visa itself is arrival-issued rather than electronic.

unresolved.reason: FCDO says a visa is required but also that the borders have been closed to general entry since 2020. The taxonomy has no closed-border or entry-prohibited state, so an ordinary advance-visa classification would be misleading.
FCDO says a visa is required but does not establish issuance timing or a normalized electronic, advance or arrival route; the Afghan embassy in London is closed.
FCDO says the traveller needs the right Libyan visa but the required type and recognition vary by trip and port of entry; no passport-wide route is established.

No current FCDO entry-requirements page was available under the ordinary Palestine route, and Palestinian-territory travel is governed by controlling external border routes. No passport-only status is inferred.

FCDO links an online Syrian visa application and decision-status service, but does not establish that an electronically issued visa is delivered or an arrival/advance route for this passport; Syria's eVisa service requires destination-side verification.

FCDO says a visa is required and may be applied for online or through the embassy, but online application alone does not prove an electronically issued visa and no passport-wide issuance route was established.
No current FCDO Republic of the Congo entry-requirements page was located at the ordinary country route and no current destination-side ordinary-passport route was verified.
